name: IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision

page_limit_content.note: 正文（含全部图、表）上限 8 页；仅含参考文献的额外页不计入

evidence.quote: Papers are limited to eight pages, including figures and tables, in the ICCV style. Additional pages containing only cited references are allowed.

references_counted.note: 参考文献不计入 8 页正文

evidence.quote: Additional pages containing only cited references are allowed.

appendix_allowed.note: 依据 ICCV 2023 明文（附录计页/须移至补充材料）推断；ICCV 2025 指南仅提“仅参考文献可额外”，未再单列附录

evidence.quote: Appendices may not be a part of the additional pages. Appendices are counted towards the eight-page limit or should be moved to the supplementary document.

paper_size.note: 官方 iccv.sty 声明使用 letter 纸张

evidence.quote: \PackageWarningNoLine{iccv}{Incorrect paper size - ICCV uses paper size `letter'. Please load document class `article' with `letterpaper' option}
\documentclass[10pt,twocolumn,letterpaper]{article}
Type main text in 10-point Times, single-spaced.

section_numbering.note: 一级标题形如 1. Introduction（Times 12pt 粗体，左对齐）

evidence.quote: (For example, {\large \bf 1. Introduction}) should be Times 12-point boldface, initially capitalized, flush left, with one blank line before, and one blank line after.

anonymity.note: 双盲评审；不得在致谢/补充材料泄露身份

evidence.quote: ICCV reviewing is double blind, in that authors do not know the names of the area chairs or reviewers for their papers, and the area chairs/reviewers cannot, beyond a reasonable doubt, infer the names of the authors from the submission and the additional material.

submission_system.note: ICCV 2025 使用 OpenReview（2021/2023 用 CMT）

evidence.quote: ICCV 2025 will be using OpenReview to manage submissions.

page_numbering.value: review version numbered, camera-ready no page numbers
page_numbering.note: 送审版加页码；camera-ready 不加

evidence.quote: The review version should have page numbers, yet the final version submitted as camera ready should not show any page numbers.

supplementary_policy.value: optional supplementary material (videos, proofs, extra figures/tables); code encouraged, anonymized
supplementary_policy.note: 补充材料可选、独立提交；不得含额外数据集/改进结果

evidence.quote: Supplementary material may include videos, proofs, additional figures or tables, more detailed analysis of experiments presented in the paper, or a concurrent submission to another conference.

figure_caption_position.note: 官方模板 figure 示例中 \caption 位于图内容之后、\end{figure} 之前 → 图题在图下方；ICCV 指南未明文

table_caption_position.note: 官方模板 table 示例中 \caption 置于 tabular 之后 → 表题在表下方（与 CVPR/ICCV 指南缺省相反）；ICCV 指南未明文

evidence.quote: Figure and table captions should be 9-point Roman type as in \cref{fig:onecol,fig:short}.

reference_style_hint.note: 参考文献 9-point Times、按数字编号

evidence.quote: List and number all bibliographical references in 9-point Times, single-spaced, at the end of your paper.
Use Times 8-point type, single-spaced.
